title: 7.5 Liters of Water in 3 Hours — The Hidden Physics of Water Intoxication

shots.vo: January 2007, California ke ek live FM radio show mein ek ajeeb contest rakha gaya.
Apne bachon ke liye gaming console jeetne ka rule simple tha — bina washroom gaye sabse zyada paani peena.
28 saal ki Jennifer Strange ne mahez teen ghante mein saadhe saat liter paani pee liya.
Studio se nikalte waqt live mic par usne kaha — mera sar dard se phat raha hai.
Aur sirf paanch ghante baad, apne hi kamre mein woh hamesha ke liye khamosh mili.
Postmortem report mein na koi zeher tha, na koi chot — maut ki wajah thi sirf saaf peene ka paani.
Humein bachpan se lagta hai jitna zyada paani piyoge body utni detox hogi — par yeh ek khatarnaak myth hai.
Kyunki aapki dono kidneys ke paas paani filter karne ki ek strict biological speed limit hoti hai.
Healthy kidneys ek ghante mein maximum sirf zero point eight se ek liter paani hi bahar nikaal sakti hain.
Jennifer har ghante dhai liter paani andar bhej rahi thi — yaani exit speed se teen guna tez!
Jo extra paani bahar nahi nikal paaya, woh seedha khoon ki nason mein bharne laga.
Hamare khoon mein maujood sodium har ek nerve signal aur fluid balance ko control karta hai.
Normal insaan ke blood mein sodium bilkul ek sau chaalis millimoles per liter par lock rehta hai.
Jab achanak kai liter paani khoon mein milta hai, toh khoon patla hokar sodium ko dilute kar deta hai.
Jab yeh level gir kar ek sau athaarah ke neeche jaata hai, doctors isse Acute Hyponatremia kehte hain.
Yahan physics ka ek simple niyam kaam karta hai, Osmosis — paani hamesha zyada namak ki taraf bhaagta hai.
Khoon mein namak kam aur cells ke andar zyada hone se, paani tezi se cells ke andar ghusne lagta hai.
Haath aur pair ke cells phool jayein toh jagah mil jaati hai — par aapka dimaag kahan phailaga?
Hamara dimaag charon taraf se saat millimeter moti thos haddi ki khopdi mein band hota hai.
Jaise hi paani brain cells ke andar bharta hai, dimaag phoolne lagta hai par bahar nikalne ki koi jagah nahi hoti.
Badhta hua pressure khopdi ke andar ki khoon ki nason ko daba kar oxygen supply rok deta hai.
Aakhir mein phoola hua dimaag neeche ke iklaute chhed, Foramen Magnum mein dhas jaata hai.
Wahin par brainstem hota hai — jo aapki saans aur dil ki dhadkan ka main switchboard hai.
Brainstem dabte hi saans aur dhadkan dono ke switches ek saath band ho jaate hain.
Yeh sirf radio contest mein nahi hota — Boston Marathon study mein terah percent runners mein yahi condition mili.
Aur chheh mahine se chhote bachon ki kidneys chhoti hone ki wajah se unhein saadha paani bilkul nahi diya jaata.
Emergency ICU mein doctors mareez ko saadha paani nahi, balki three percent gaadha salt solution chadhate hain.
Apne aap ko safe rakhne ke teen rules yaad rakhiye — Rule one: ek ghante mein aath sau ML se zyada paani mat pijiye.
Rule two: bhaari workout ya garmi mein paseena bahaane par paani ke saath electrolytes ya ORS zaroor lein.
Rule three: halka peela rang perfect hydration ki nishani hai — bilkul paani jaisa transparent hona rukne ka signal hai.
Zeher aur amrit mein farq sirf maatra ka hota hai — sahi matra mein hi paani jeevan hai.
Yeh reel apne har runner aur gym partner ke saath abhi share kijiye.
